description: This file contains functions related to system boot processes, such as handling init hooks, pivoting root filesystems, and managing overlays in an embedded Linux environment (specifically OpenWrt).

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_start
methods.description: Sets a flag indicating the start of a splicing hook.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_finish
methods.description: Completes splicing hooks by processing the list of hooks and resetting related variables.

methods.name: boot_hook_init
methods.description: Initializes a new hook and adds it to the stack list.

methods.name: boot_hook_add
methods.description: Adds a function to a specified boot hook.

methods.name: boot_hook_shift
methods.description: Removes and returns the first function from a hook's list.

methods.name: boot_run_hook
methods.description: Executes all functions associated with a specified hook, preventing duplicate runs.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Performs a pivot root operation for changing the root filesystem.

methods.name: fopivot
methods.description: Sets up an overlay filesystem and pivots it as the new root.

methods.name: ramoverlay
methods.description: Creates an in-memory overlay filesystem for root.
